evaluation_rules._note: comparison semantics live in tested code (44.29)

_calibration: Live wording seen 2026-09-13: a partner agreement 'within [30] days of the invoice date'; two customer MSAs bill 'by the 25th day of the month' / 'Grace Period 15 (fifteen) days from the due date' — neither states a day-count from the invoice date and would fall to a person (UNKNOWN), correctly. Negotiable per §16: Net-30 'subject to commercial approval'.
'business days' is listed as a DAYS term deliberately so the reader is told the unit was read; whether business days equal calendar days is the owner's call, not a conversion (AM-62 r1).
